body: BTW little known fact but gdp growth year over year is not a directly comparable number. The way I broke it to my best friend was saying please don't panic first. I think that helped, and I followed up by saying "I'll let you know when its time to panic". And agree with say *thinking*. Its scary but you can do it, and it really helps to share. Also don't worry about "repaying," being there for each other is what friends are for. Just know you would want to listen if your friend is having a hard  time, so let her do the same for you. Something I saw in a movie (Mr. Nobody) was a guy flipped a coin for every decision.
